messages:
anya: Quick RFC follow-up on enrichment fallback semantics — when an attribute lookup (tenant/service owner, billing key, etc.) misses, do we: 1) fallthrough to aggregator heuristics (best-effort guess), or 2) mark as unknown/pending and attempt late/backfill enrichment? Need to capture tradeoffs and proposed rollout.

mike: Short take: fallthrough reduces immediate tail latency but creates noisy/incorrect buckets and makes cost attribution fuzzy. We see cardinality blowups if guesses are wrong.

leo: Agree with mike. If aggregator guesses by IP/host/route, misattribution risk is high (esp multi-tenant infra). Prefer mark-as-pending + backfill for high-value keys.

anya: Two operational concerns: latency SLO (we can't block critical paths) and query shape (if too many pending rows, dashboards explode).

leo: Proposal: hybrid behavior — on miss emit record with "user_tenant":"pending" and "enrichment_status":"pending" and enqueue an enrichment_ticket event to a fast side-channel. Aggregator treats "pending" as a temporary tombstone for a configurable window (eg 30s). If enrichment resolves within window, emit a correction/update event; otherwise downgrade to "tenant:unknown".

Here is a tiny example payload idea:```json
{
  "req_id": "abc123",
  "user_tenant": "pending",
  "enrichment_status": "pending",
  "enrich_ticket_id": "E-9876",
  "ts": 3770012345
}
```

tanya: Two followups: 1) storage/retention costs for holding pending envelopes and 2) deletion/compaction strategy for corrective events (so we don't keep N correction rows forever). Also need SRE input on the side-channel throughput.

mike: For metrics/observability we should add enrichment_status tag values: [hit, miss, pending, backfilled, corrected]. Instrument: miss-rate, pending-time-percentile, correction-success-rate, and contribution-to-query-cardinality. Billing pipeline needs mapping rules: only attribute costs to tenant when enrichment_status in [hit, corrected, backfilled-success].

ingest-bot: Created ticket E-9876 for "enrichment fallback experiment" assigned to @leo and @anya — https://go/repo/issue/E-9876 :white_check_mark:

leo: I'll prototype the side-channel + aggregator TTL logic. Plan: on miss -> emit pending, TTL=30s. If we get enrichment within TTL, emit correction event: {req_id, old:pending, new:tenant=X}. Aggregator applies delta correction (decrement unknown bucket, increment tenant bucket).

tanya: Suggestion for rollout: 5% traffic experiment (canary) measuring: a) increased latency for paths that trigger enrichment, b) change in cardinality and dashboard noise, c) cost delta in billing attribution. Run 48h window then evaluate.

anya: :thumbsup: I'll draft a short RFC with schema examples, metric names, and ramp plan. Also cc SRE for storage/throughput constraints. Next step: leo + mike to produce simple sim and rough cost estimate before RFC lands.

mike: One more: be explicit about idempotency keys for correction events and retention TTLs so aggregator can dedupe.

anya: Noted — I'll include idempotency and retention/compaction options in the RFC. Thanks all.
